headline: JUDGE 🧑‍⚖️ SLAMS 💥 Lizzo's LAWSUIT 🍔 into the TRASH 🗑️
text:
LIZZO 🎤 is straight up GRATEFUL 🙌 after that DISTRICT 🏛️ judge just YEETED 🏀 the remaining CLAIMS 📜 against her PRODUCTION 🏭 company Big Grrrl Big Touring right outta the COURTROOM 🚪 on Tuesday!! The US pop star whose real name is Melissa Viviane Jefferson dropped an INSTAGRAM 📸 post saying she feels so RELIEVED 😌 and will keep FIGHTING 🥊 every single vicious claim made against her and her businesses like the absolute QUEEN 👑 she is!! Former wardrobe assistant Asha Daniels had alleged all kinds of DEGRADATION 😣 forced physical LABOR 🛠️ denial of MEDICAL 🩹 care sexual HARASSMENT 🫦 and racial HARASSMENT 🫦 while working briefly in 2023 but the judge said NAH 🚫 to that noise!! "The TRUTH 🕵️ matters to me more than ANYTHING 🌍" Lizzo typed while thanking her LAWYERS 👔 and sending LOVE 💌 to all her supporters who been riding with her through this whole mess bro!!

District JUDGE 🧑‍⚖️ Fernando L Aenlle-Rocha filed the RULING 📋 to DISMISS 🗑️ those claims by the STYLIST ✂️ according to court documents and previously in 2024 he already ruled that Daniels could NOT 🛑 sue the GRAMMY 🏆 winner as an individual but the company stayed a DEFENDANT ⚖️!! This week he COOKED 🍳 the case by saying the former assistant didn't point to any conduct showing general HOSTILITY 😡 to women in the WORKPLACE 🏢 or disparate treatment of MEN 👨 and WOMEN 👩 at all!! He wrote that the alleged conduct while INAPPROPRIATE 😬 and unprofessional still fell within the scope of what the SUPREME COURT ⚖️ has held to be outside protection from the ordinary TRIBULATIONS 🥲 of the workplace like come on now!! The judge also hit that incident where the stylist claims her FOOT 🦶 got run over by a heavy CLOTHES RACK 🧥 saying while the court does not seek to MINIMIZE 🙅 the pain felt those injuries DO NOT qualify as disabilities under the AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT ♿!!

Lizzo's team been DENYING 🚫 all that from the JUMP 🦘 and she made it crystal CLEAR 📢 in her post that she will not SETTLE 💰 and will continue to FIGHT 🛡️ every vicious claim that has been made against her and her BUSINESSES 🏪!! The About Damn Time singer poured out her HEART ❤️ thanking her lawyers and promising to keep using her PLATFORM 📣 to spread POSITIVITY ✨ and light to the world before signing off with LOVE ❤️ to her supporters who stayed DOWN 🫡!! Daniels lawyer Ron Zambrano dropped a statement saying they are DISAPPOINTED 😞 with the ruling and believe the decision improperly weighed EVIDENCE 📊 that should have been evaluated by a JURY 👥 instead!! He noted they disagree that the stylist twisting her ANKLE 🦵 and limping while trying to work does not meet the legal standard of a disability under the ADA and called these important ISSUES 🔥 because claims often depend on how a jury evaluates the full WORKPLACE 🏢 environment the surrounding context and disputed FACTS 📋!!

This whole LAWSUIT 📋 from Asha Daniels was filed back in September 2023 right after a separate SUIT 🧳 filed by three of Lizzo's former TOUR 🚌 dancers that included sexual HARASSMENT 🫦 claims which Lizzo's team has always DENIED 🙅‍♀️!! Allegations of fat-shaming from that same earlier lawsuit got DISMISSED 🗑️ by a judge in 2025 so the pattern is looking real CLEAR 🔎 for anyone paying ATTENTION 👀!! The judge this week specifically said the conduct while inappropriate still didn't rise to the level that would trigger HOSTILE 🏚️ work environment protections or disparate treatment findings which basically means the court saw it as part of the rough and tumble of showbiz life on the ROAD 🛣️!! Lizzo been through some DARK 🌑 times amid all these legal BATTLES ⚔️ but she keeps bouncing back like the built different ICON 🏆 she is and her supporters are eating it UP 🍽️ with every positive post she drops!!

In the RULING 📜 the judge emphasized he does not seek to MINIMIZE 🐜 or disregard the pain felt by the stylist but those injuries from the clothes rack incident simply DO NOT qualify as disabilities under the ADA which was a major pillar of the claims!! Ron Zambrano fired back that they respectfully DISAGREE 😤 with the court's approach and are considering appropriate NEXT STEPS 🚶‍♂️ because these matters deserve full jury scrutiny on the workplace ENVIRONMENT 🌡️ surrounding context and all the disputed FACTS 📑!! Lizzo meanwhile is out here staying GRATEFUL 🙏 and relieved while promising to keep FIGHTING 🥊 for her name and her BRAND 🛍️ because the truth matters more than anything to her and she ain't settling for less PERIODT 🛑!! The pop star signed off her Instagram with love to her FANS 👯‍♀️ who been holding her down through every vicious claim and legal DRAMA 🎭!!

BBC 📺 already reached out to Lizzo's lawyers for COMMENT 💬 on the latest developments but the singer is clearly READY 🏋️ to move forward spreading positivity while her legal team handles the remaining loose ENDS 🧵!! This dismissal comes after multiple rounds of claims getting tossed including the fat-shaming ALLEGATIONS 🗣️ so the About Damn Time hitmaker is slowly but surely clearing her name one RULING 📋 at a time and her supporters are HERE 📍 for every single victory lap she decides to take on the Gram!! Daniels side says they will keep evaluating options because they believe the full story belongs in front of a JURY 🧑‍⚖️ but for now the court has spoken and Lizzo is breathing a huge sigh of RELIEF 🌬️ while recommitting to her mission of light and love in the INDUSTRY 🎤!!
